name: Company secretary
summary: How foreign founders engage company secretaries in Singapore — ACRA filings, nominee vs advisory scope, annual returns, and what a CS does not replace in tax or immigration advice.
body:
Singapore private companies need a qualified company secretary within timelines after incorporation. CS providers handle registers, annual returns, officer changes, and some compliance calendars. They are not a substitute for tax agents, employment counsel, or MOM pass strategy.

## Scope to define
- Incorporation package vs ongoing secretarial retainer
- Registered office and nominee director rules (if any)
- Annual return and AGM support
- Share allotment / officer change filings
- Who holds the CorpPass and Bizfile access

Founders still own statutory deadlines even when a CS is appointed.

## How to choose
Prefer firms that name the qualified secretary and response SLAs. Ask what is excluded (accounting, payroll, XP tax). Confirm CorpPass admin handoff when you leave Singapore.

## Practical tip
Calendar ACRA deadlines in your own phone, not only the CS portal. Silent renewals fail when email aliases change after a job move.
